sql: select 1 sec, to_char(o.created_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') a, o.market_ticker b, o.side||'/'||o.action c, o.status d, o.quantity::text||'@'||coalesce(o.limit_price::text,'') e, left(coalesce(o.client_order_id,''),24) f from live_orders o where o.strategy='Alimm1' and o.created_at > now() - interval '3 hours' union all select 2, to_char(b.at,'MM-DD HH24:MI'), b.balance_cents::text, 'res='||coalesce(b.residual_cents::text,'-'), 'f='||coalesce(b.fills_counted::text,'-')||' s='||coalesce(b.settlements_counted::text,'-'), '', left(coalesce(b.notes_json::text,'null'),120) from incentive_balance_observations b where b.at > now() - interval '2.5 hours' order by 1, 2 desc limit 30
